verdicts.notes: Gaunt skull-like face with bared teeth, long stringy dark hair, greenish emaciated skeletal torso and tattered waist wrap match the anchor's true monster form closely.

This is an interior room, not the courtyard exterior itself, but the wood-lattice paper window over a brick sill and dark-wood furnishings are consistent with the anchor's construction materials and era; reads as inside the same residence complex.

This is the sliver of a man peeking through a door at night, wearing a dark-blue/grey robe consistent with the reference, but only one eye and brow are visible and he wears a wrapped black headscarf rather than the reference's flat squared cap with ribbon — plausible as an undressed night look but worth a human glance.
Ghoul holding up the painted skin cloak in front of the bookshelf shows the same gaunt skeletal build, long dark hair and greenish tattered wrap as the anchor's true form.

This shows an enclosed study with bookshelf/writing desk rather than the courtyard exterior; material palette (dark wood, paper lattice, warm lamp light) is consistent with the anchor's era/materials though the specific structure can't be directly cross-checked against the exterior shot.

P003 shows an open door to a sunlit courtyard plus a curtained daybed on the right; P005's study framing shows a bookshelf and writing desk instead — same dark-wood/warm-lamp interior style but the specific furniture layout isn't directly verifiable as the same room, worth a look.
Same bearded elder with topknot and grey-blue robe as the reference; he wields a sword and jug instead of the reference's fly-whisk, a props change for this action beat, not a costume/identity drift.
The exorcised creature retains the anchor's gaunt greenish skeletal form, long dark hair and tattered wrap; correctly kept as the ghoul form rather than being simplified into a mundane creature.
Grey brick walls, tiled roofline, stone-paved courtyard floor, potted plants, and the alley receding to further brick buildings all match the anchor almost exactly.

P008 is an enclosed dim interior bedroom (bed, hanging curtain, small candlelit side table) while P009 is a bright open exterior brick courtyard/alley with tiled roofs — this is not a camera move within one room but a jump to an entirely different physical space, so layout/lighting/axis do not carry over at all.

Reference shows hair in a neat low bun; here in this grief/rescue beat her hair is loose and flowing, understandable emotional-state variation but a visible hairstyle departure from the anchor worth a glance; robe tone and slender build otherwise consistent.
Man lying wounded on the bed shows the same facial structure and dark blue-grey robe as the reference; black head covering reads consistent with the reference cap even lying down.

Interior bedroom with wood bed frame and hanging fabric drapery, consistent dark-wood/era material palette with the exterior anchor though the exact structure isn't directly comparable to an outdoor shot.

Both panels show the same bed with matching frame/headboard style, a hanging curtain in the same position, and warm low candlelight — consistent continuation of the same bedroom as the story beat advances.
Same black scholar cap, teal-grey robe with white collar and dark sash, and slim build as reference; face angled/downcast in panel but consistent hairline and features.
Panel shows the human-disguise form matching the anchor's left figure: same loose long hair with top hairpin, mauve/red wrap top over blue-grey pleated skirt, slender build.

Anchor is a private brick courtyard residence with tiled roof, lattice windows and a canal; panel P002 is an open-air market street with awning stalls and a distant city gate tower — a different building type/location entirely, not merely a different camera angle.
P001 is a night-time interior room (monster painting a portrait at a desk by lamplight); P002 is a daytime outdoor market street — no shared layout, light direction, or axis between the two panels.
Kneeling figure retains the same black scholar cap, teal robe, white collar and sash, and slim build; face consistent though partly shadowed in the night scene.
Grey robe, black waist wrap, goatee beard and hair topknot all match the reference exactly; holding a different prop (whisk vs fan) does not affect identity.

Anchor's landmark is a thick city-wall gate tower with a carved archway; panel P006 instead shows a freestanding temple gate on a stepped platform flanked by stone lions — a different gate structure, not the same building re-angled.

P004 is overcast daylight with the gate tower distant on the right; P006 is full night with a different-looking temple gate now in the left foreground — lighting flips from day to night and the landmark structure itself differs, not just camera position.
White blouse over tan/brown pleated skirt and low hair bun match the reference; kneeling praying pose does not obscure key identity features.
Grey robe, dark sash, beard and topknot consistent with reference; holding scroll/pouch instead of fan is just scene prop, not an identity change.

Same wooden double doors, lattice windows and stone-paved patio with potted plants as the anchor; the wider shot additionally reveals the market street beyond the gate, consistent with a residence opening onto the market.

Building doors/patio carry over from P009, but P009's distinctive canal-with-railing feature on the right is absent in P010, replaced by an open market street; plausible if camera panned toward the gate, but worth a manual spot-check.

Low hair bun with side strands and hairpin matches reference; face is shown mostly from behind/side in a dark night scene and skirt color is obscured by shadow, so identity cannot be fully confirmed but nothing contradicts it.
Lying figure retains the black cap and dark blue-grey robe consistent with reference; eyes closed (unconscious) prevents full facial comparison but face shape/hairline match.

P014 is a dark interior bedroom (bed, cushions, curtain) with no exterior architectural elements visible, so it cannot be directly compared against the anchor's exterior courtyard view; nothing in the furniture/wood tones contradicts the same period residence.
Same bed, cushions, curtain and camera angle continue directly from P013 to P014; this is the same continuous moment with identical lighting and axis.
黑色平顶方巾、藏青色宽袖长袍配白色内搭、腰间深色系带均与参考完全一致，侧脸五官与发际线吻合。
白色上衣配棕黄色长裙、低发髻与参考一致，脸型圆润度与眉眼与参考吻合。
窗外仅可见一个人影剪影（似为伏笔镜头），无可辨认的五官/服饰花纹细节，无法与锚点图的人形/真身两种形态精确比对；轮廓体型不矛盾，未见明显物种错误，但建议人工复核该剪影身份。
室内深色木格窗、门外可见的院落石铺地面与盆栽，与锚点院落的建筑形制、木作用材及时代气质一致，仅因本格为室内视角未完整展示院落全貌。
P002为雨天集市街道（远景城门楼、摊棚苫布、泥泞道路，风格更接近LOC_MARKET_TEMPLE而非王家院落），P003为室内厅堂（暗色木案、油灯、软榻），空间布局与光源冷暖完全不同，怀疑该背景延续性标注与LOC_WANG_COURTYARD锚点不符。
惊坐起男子的黑色平顶巾、脸型五官与参考一致；因被褥遮挡下半身，可见的藏青色外袍与参考基本吻合。
攻击者呈灰绿鬼脸獠牙、蓬乱长发，与锚点"真身"骷髅脸相符；但仍穿着近似人形伪装期的红棕色衣衫（锚点真身为裸露褴褛下裙无上衣），服装与体型呈人形/真身混合状态，建议人工复核是否为有意的撕皮显形过渡设计。
卧房木隔墙、字画卷轴、门外夜色下的院落建筑轮廓与锚点院落风格及时代气质一致。
P005为书房场景（书架、烛台、条案，男主在门外窥视），P007为卧房场景（床榻、床头柜），两格家具配置与房间功能完全不同，虽同为暖色夜间光源，但门窗/家具方位无法视为同一镜头的延续，怀疑该背景延续性标注有误。
跪地女子的白色上衣、棕黄色长裙、发髻样式与参考完全一致，脸型五官吻合。
蓬乱灰白发髻、破烂多层衣衫、竹杖与锚点一致，因下蹲姿态体型有透视变化但整体比例吻合。
背景城门楼形制、泥地道路、两侧民居与锚点集市庙门场景风格一致。
两格同一城门楼、石狮、右侧摊棚与泥地布局延续，光位均为傍晚/夜间冷暗色调，轴线基本一致。
本格施加了颗粒状白色特效纹理（表现施术/元气外泄），使面部与衣料细节模糊，但发髻轮廓、脸型与服装剪影仍与CHAR_CHEN参考一致，判断为场景特效而非角色漂移，建议人工复核纹理是否为有意VFX。
闭眼平躺男子的黑色头巾轮廓、脸型与参考CHAR_WANG基本一致，因特效纹理覆盖细节略显模糊但服装色调仍可辨认为同一角色。
深色木窗棂、床帐帘布陈设与锚点院落室内木作风格及时代气质一致。
同一房间机位拉近（P014→P015），床榻/窗棂/柜架位置与暖色夜间光源方向保持一致，仅镜头拉近未改变场景结构。
同款黑方巾、深青绿长袍、白色内领与黑腰带在panel与front/anchor间完全一致，脸型五官无偏差。
白须、发髻簪、灰蓝长袍与手持流苏物件均与参考一致；panel中因手臂姿势遮挡未见参考里明显的斜挎黑带，判定为姿态差异非漂移。
泥泞土路、茅棚摊位、远处叠檐城门楼与参考锚图建筑形制、材质完全一致。
发髻中分、圆润面容与白色上衣均与参考一致；跪姿被桌案遮挡未见下裙，无法完全核实但无冲突证据。
黑方巾、脸型轮廓与参考一致；因重伤昏迷躺卧衣襟敞开露胸，未见完整青绿长袍属剧情合理状态变化。
panel为室内视角、锚图为室外院落，二者木格窗棂样式与深色木料、灰调墙面材质高度一致，建筑风格无冲突；因取景为室内-室外的不同侧面，无法逐一比对完全同一结构点，故不给满分。
两格均为门/窗居左、床铺居右的布局，主光源方位一致；P007为夜袭冷月光、P008转为暖色调符合剧情次日情节，非光位翻转。
发髻与柔和面容与参考一致；穿的是浅色寝衣而非日常白衫+棕裙组合，符合夜间场景的合理换装，非角色错置。
被抱之人面部埋入陈氏怀中、标志性黑方巾不可见，无法从画面直接核实脸部/服饰细节，建议人工复核；体型比例与参考无冲突。
室内深色木桌、木家具与整体灰褐色调与院落宅邸的木石材质、年代气质一致，未见风格冲突。
P010为宅院门口白日外景、P012为室内夜景烛光，取景面完全不同故无法逐一比对同一结构，但两者无直接矛盾证据；日夜光色差异较大，建议结合剧本确认是否为时间跳跃。
黑方巾、青绿长袍、脸型五官与参考完全一致。
画中院内晾衣女子为侧背影小插图且以灰调速写风格呈现，五官不可见、服色因去饱和处理难辨，仅发髻轮廓与体型与参考相符，建议人工复核。
木格窗棂样式、深色木书架与整体材质年代气质与院落宅邸一致。
P015中深色书架/柜位于画面左侧、窗棂居中偏右；P016中同款书架却出现在画面右侧、窗棂居中偏左，家具左右位置发生镜像翻转而非合理的反打机位，怀疑场景结构被镜像/翻转。
